== Trivia ==
*The '''Campfire Initiates'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s name matches up with the {{Item|Campfire Initiate Badge}}, suggesting that the '''Campfire Initiates''' have earned that badge.
**It also suggests that they have been part of {{NPCSprite|Ryan}}'s Campfire Cult for less time than the {{NPCSprite|Campfire Adept}}.
*The '''Campfire Initiates''' are part of {{NPCSprite|Ryan}}'s Campfire Cult, along with the {{NPCSprite|Campfire Adept}}.
